- Build a complete, playable kingdom-conquest game from the user’s brief: “Unlimited conquer game, sords and Spears, kingdoms, economy, lands, buttls.”

## Requirements
- Implement the game now without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support mobile-friendly gameplay and touch controls.

## Decisions
- Built a single-file browser strategy game called Ironvale, with a procedurally generated tile map, four kingdoms, economy, troops, building, battles, AI rivals, and local saves.
- Assumed “unlimited conquer” means defeated kingdoms can be replaced by new rivals once the known world has no rival territories.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game UI, map rendering, kingdom economy, land claiming, troop movement/recruitment, buildings, combat, AI turns, and local save in `index.html`.
- Confirmed JavaScript syntax with `node --check /tmp/ironvale.js`.

- Saved and inspected `screenshots/ironvale.jpg`.

- None.

1. Optionally test gameplay interactions and refine combat/AI edge cases.

- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/ironvale.jpg`: Latest visual check.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable kingdom-conquest game from the brief: “Unlimited conquer game, sords and Spears, kingdoms, economy, lands, buttls.”

## Requirements
- Implement without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Support mobile-friendly gameplay and touch controls.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at viewport widths no greater than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built Ironvale as a single-file browser strategy game with a procedurally generated tile map, four kingdoms, economy, troops, building, combat, AI rivals, and local saves.
- Interpreted “unlimited conquer” as allowing new rival kingdoms to rise when no rival territory remains.

- Implemented game UI, map rendering, kingdom economy, land claiming, troop movement/recruitment, buildings, combat, AI turns, and local saves in `index.html`.
